episodes.title: I almost volunteered here... then I saw RED FLAGS
episodes.description:
We were in Bristol expecting to get on a train in the morning to spend the next two weeks volunteering at a Buddhist center in England…
But after doing more research about the organization and its history, we came across enough red flags that we no longer felt comfortable. Instead of ignoring our instincts, we made a last-minute decision to change our plans completely! With no back-up plan or somewhere else to go and England stretching our budget, we booked a cheap one-way flight to Morocco and started a brand new adventure!!
 
DISCLAIMER: I am not 100% that the center is a confirmed cult. I will not be sharing the specific center, nor which tradition of Buddhist the center was and because of this I will not be sharing the specific research we found to lead us down the rabbit hole. 

In this vlog, you'll hear what changed our minds, the stressful scramble to make a new plan, and our unexpected journey from England to Morocco. Sometimes the best travel experiences begin when everything goes wrong and I am so excited to be back traveling in Morocco!!


✨ Thanks for Watching!
I’m so grateful for your support on my channel. My goal is to inspire you to try something new, travel the world, and step out of your comfort zone!
